verdict.rationale: Navan documents per-transaction activity history via its API, and its MCP tooling can explain why a transaction was flagged, who must approve it, and which policy applies. Together with its policy and approval workflows, this covers the core of a per-expense trail, but the evidence never shows field-level edit history, immutable or tamper-evident records, retention, or auditor-ready export. missing for 10: explicit edit/change logging detail, immutable/tamper-evident audit records, retention guarantees, audit export or reporting for external auditors, independent or hands-on corroboration.
